decision.rationale: TXN-007936 (BRIGHTWATER GADGETS, 345.58 EUR, card CRD-000014) was posted on 2026-06-09. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, which is 143 days after posting. The policy allows 120 days. Under the rule order, the time limit is checked first, and a dispute opened late is declined whatever else the evidence shows. Authorisation AUTH-008142 does look like possible fraud: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and the fraud flag set. However, the policy says the time limit still applies when a transaction carries fraud indicators, so these signs do not change the outcome.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 143 days after the transaction was posted on 2026-06-09. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, and this limit applies even when a transaction is marked as possible fraud.
